items.title: 2.11 Mantiq par mabni istidlal aur inference (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Logic par mabni reasoning aur inference sochne ke aise tareeqe hain jo maloom facts se nateeje nikalne mein madad dete hain. Is tareeqe mein logic ke qaide istemal kar ke qadam ba qadam nateeje tak pohancha jata hai. Reasoning se hum masle hal karte, faisle karte aur maloomat ki tasdeeq (verify) karte hain. Logical inference yaqeeni banata hai ke nateeje sahi aur qabil-e-aitbaar hon. Yeh concept samajhne se critical thinking (parakh kar sochne) ki skill barhti hai. Asal duniya ke mushkil masle hal karne ke liye logic par mabni reasoning zaroori hai.

Logical inference maloom maloomat se naye facts nikalne ka amal hai. Yeh reasoning ka aisa tareeqa hai jo logic ke qaidon par chalta hai. Maslan agar hum jante hain “Tamam insaan faani hain (sab ko maut aani hai)” aur “Socrates insaan hai,” to hum nateeja nikal sakte hain ke “Socrates faani hai.” Agar premises (shuru ki di hui baatein) sach hon to logical inference ka nateeja bhi sach hota hai. Yeh maths, computer science aur artificial intelligence mein istemal hota hai. Inference saboot (evidence) ki bunyad par faisle karne mein madad deta hai aur logic aur reasoning ka bunyadi concept hai.

Deduction reasoning ki aisi qism hai jo aam (general) facts se shuru ho kar ek khaas (specific) nateeje tak pohanchti hai. Deduction mein “if-then” (agar-to) jaise logical qaide istemal hote hain. Maslan “Agar barish ho to zameen geeli hoti hai” aur “Barish ho rahi hai” se nateeja nikalta hai “Zameen geeli hai.” Deduction par bharosa kiya ja sakta hai kyunke agar premises sach hon to nateeja yaqeenan sach hota hai. Computer masle hal karne aur sawalon ke jawab dene ke liye deduction istemal karte hain. Deduction formal reasoning aur problem solving ke kaamon mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: “Agar number 4 se poora taqseem (divide) ho to woh even hai. 12, 4 se poora taqseem hota hai.” Kya nateeja nikalta hai? Kya ulti baat “Agar number even ho to woh 4 se taqseem hota hai” sahi hai?
blocks.explanation: Nateeja: 12 even hai. Ulti baat sahi nahi: 6 even hai lekin 4 se poora taqseem nahi hota. Yani “to” wala hissa sach ho to “agar” wala hissa khud sabit nahi hota.

items: Inference: maloom facts se logic ke qaidon par naye facts nikalna (Socrates ki misal).
Deduction: aam qaida + khaas fact = khaas nateeja (barish aur geeli zameen).
Premises sach hon to sahi deduction ka nateeja yaqeenan sach hota hai.
